_doc: Per-entity deep dive: grid posture, how risk manifests, cover stack, mining gaps. Merged into profiles.json at build. No synthetic policy numbers — use evidenced | inferred_typical | absent | unknown.

risk_manifestation.headline: string
risk_manifestation.mechanism: How the loss happens (grid, contract, revenue)

gaps: what we still need from filings / broker / ECR

mining.method_note: One sentence on how this profile was built

grid_posture.dno: UK Power Networks (Essex — inferred from site)
grid_posture.constraint_zone: Single UKPN distribution boundary — Loughton, Essex

risk_manifestation.headline: Lawful curtailment — no damage trigger
risk_manifestation.mechanism: TSO/DNO reduces available import/export under non-firm or queue terms; GPU load idles or shifts to diesel without physical damage to insured plant.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Standard PD/BI wordings do not respond — curtailment is not a damage event (LMA BI guidance).
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: trigger_gap 4/4 — maximal physical-damage vs non-damage mismatch

risk_manifestation.headline: Energisation slip in congested queue
risk_manifestation.mechanism: 700 GW+ UK demand-connection queue (OFGEM/NESO reform context) delays firm energisation past Q4 2026 target; revenue and debt service continue on unproven grid.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Delay-in-startup / advanced loss of profits may exist on CAR but curtailment after energisation remains uninsured.
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: tenor_mismatch 4/4 — multi-year capex vs zero operating curtailment history

risk_manifestation.headline: One campus, one constraint node
risk_manifestation.mechanism: 50–90 MW AI load on a single greenfield site shares one constraint boundary — correlated outage or curtailment hits the entire UK book slice.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Property cat and BI aggregate at site level; grid-system curtailment correlation not priced in standard programmes.

inferred_typical.basis: Pre-energisation greenfield campus; no operational policy schedule published

inferred_typical.cover: Operational property / machinery breakdown (if bound post-COD)
inferred_typical.trigger: Physical damage + ensuing BI waiting period
inferred_typical.basis: Typical DC operational stack; not evidenced for Nscale

absent.note: No Parametrix, Descartes, Marsh Nimbus or similar placement evidenced
product_fit 0/4 — no availability product on asset or sponsor

gaps: Named lead insurer and broker on the campus programme
Bound policy wordings (CAR, DSU, operational PD/BI)
ECR/TEC row match for Loughton connection status

mining.method_note: Grid facts from sponsor disclosures and DC maps; cover stack inferred from build stage only — no synthetic carrier names.
